caption: The drawing displays a single ceramic jug with a wide cylindrical body, a rounded handle attached to its side, and a flared rim. The jug is depicted in varying shades of brown, with lighter areas showing highlights and darker tones indicating shadows and contour. The body of the jug features decorative patterns, including a series of curved lines and teardrop-shaped designs in a darker brown color, which wrap around the lower and upper sections. The surface of the jug appears smooth, and the illustration is set against a plain, light beige background. There is a small signature “H. Moran” in the lower right corner beneath the jug. No other objects are present in the composition.
